vulnerable_code:
class ContractPolicy < ApplicationPolicy
  def download_pdf?
    # Defective policy logic: checks if user is logged in and document is not archived,
    # but fails to verify that the user is the client or assigned attorney
    user.present? && !record.archived?
  end
end

class ContractsController < ApplicationController
  def download
    @contract = Contract.find(params[:id])
    authorize @contract, :download_pdf?

    send_file @contract.rendered_pdf_path, disposition: 'attachment'
  end
end
diagnosis: The ContractPolicy#download_pdf? method checks user.present? and document archival state instead of enforcing object-level ownership. Any authenticated user on the legal platform can download sensitive contracts and agreements belonging to unrelated clients.

corrected_code:
class ContractPolicy < ApplicationPolicy
  def download_pdf?
    return false unless user.present? && !record.archived?
    user.admin? || record.client_id == user.id || record.attorney_id == user.id
  end
end

class ContractsController < ApplicationController
  def download
    @contract = Contract.find(params[:id])
    authorize @contract, :download_pdf?

    send_file @contract.rendered_pdf_path, disposition: 'attachment'
  end
end
